genes.name: Liver X Receptor alpha (LXR-alpha)
genes.description: Molecular initiator (MIE 167) of AOP 34. Chemical agonists (such as T0901317) activate NR1H3, initiating a feed-forward lipogenic transcriptional cascade.

genes.name: Sterol Regulatory Element-Binding Protein 1c (SREBP-1c)
genes.description: Master transcription factor for de novo lipogenesis. Directly transcriptionally upregulated by activated LXR-alpha (NR1H3) and inhibited by PPAR-alpha.

genes.name: Fatty Acid Synthase
genes.aop_ref: OECD AOP 34 (KE 116: Up-regulation, FAS & KE 89: De Novo FA Synthesis)
genes.description: Multifunctional enzyme complex that synthesizes palmitate from acetyl-CoA and malonyl-CoA. Strongly upregulated in steatotic hepatocytes (GEO GSE126848).

genes.name: Acetyl-CoA Carboxylase Alpha (ACC1)
genes.aop_ref: OECD AOP 34 (KE 89: Increased, De Novo FA Synthesis)
genes.description: Catalyzes the rate-limiting carboxylation step of acetyl-CoA to malonyl-CoA for hepatic fatty acid synthesis.

genes.name: Stearoyl-CoA Desaturase 1 (SCD1)
genes.aop_ref: OECD AOP 34 (KE 258: Up-regulation, SCD-1 & KE 291: Triglyceride accumulation)
genes.description: Converts saturated fatty acids into monounsaturated fatty acids, essential for incorporation into neutral lipid droplets (triglycerides).

genes.name: Fatty Acid Translocase (FAT/CD36)
genes.aop_ref: OECD AOP 34 (KE 54: Up-regulation, CD36 & KE 115: FA Influx)
genes.description: Membrane transporter mediating the influx of free fatty acids from the blood into the hepatocyte. Direct target gene of LXR (NR1H3); overexpression drives lipotoxicity.

genes.name: Peroxisome Proliferator-Activated Receptor Alpha (PPAR-alpha)
genes.aop_ref: Physiological Map Homeostasis (Staumont et al., 2025: Beta-oxidation regulator)
genes.description: Central homeostatic counter-force against steatosis. Activates mitochondrial and peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation; becomes suppressed under chronic lipogenic overload.

genes.name: Carnitine Palmitoyltransferase 1A
genes.aop_ref: Physiological Map Homeostasis (Mitochondrial FA import & Beta-oxidation)
genes.description: Rate-limiting enzyme for transporting long-chain fatty acids across the mitochondrial membrane for beta-oxidation; transcriptionally driven by PPARA.

genes.name: Microsomal Triglyceride Transfer Protein
genes.description: Essential luminal protein in the endoplasmic reticulum for loading triglycerides onto APOB for hepatic VLDL export.

genes.name: Apolipoprotein B-100
genes.description: Structural core protein of VLDL particles enabling the hepatocyte to export excess triglycerides into the circulation to maintain the healthy attractor.

genes.name: Farnesoid X Receptor (FXR)
genes.aop_ref: OECD AOP 27 (KE 288: Activation of nuclear receptors / FXR adaptive feedback)
genes.description: Intracellular bile acid sensor. Upon bile salt accumulation, activates a protective feedback loop by stimulating ABCB11 and repressing CYP7A1 + SLC10A1.

genes.name: Bile Salt Export Pump (BSEP)
genes.aop_ref: OECD AOP 27 (MIE 41: Inhibition, BSEP -> KE 214: Bile acid accumulation)
genes.description: Canalicular ATP-dependent bile salt export pump and the direct molecular target (MIE 41) of cholestatic drugs such as Bosentan and Troglitazone.

genes.name: Cholesterol 7-Alpha-Monooxygenase
genes.aop_ref: OECD AOP 27 (Adaptive FXR-mediated repression of de novo bile acid synthesis)
genes.description: Rate-limiting cytochrome P450 enzyme in the classic pathway of bile acid synthesis from cholesterol. Strongly repressed via FXR/SHP during cholestasis.

genes.name: Sodium/Taurocholate Cotransporting Polypeptide (NTCP)
genes.aop_ref: OECD AOP 27 (Adaptive repression of basolateral bile acid uptake)
genes.description: Basolateral transporter responsible for >80% of conjugated bile salt uptake from sinusoidal blood into the hepatocyte.

genes.name: Nuclear Factor Erythroid 2-Related Factor 2 (Nrf2)
genes.aop_ref: OECD AOP 27 & 34 (KE 1115: Increased ROS -> Adaptive Nrf2 antioxidant response)
genes.description: Master regulator of the cellular antioxidant response. Activated by both lipotoxic ROS (AOP 34) and cytotoxic bile acid accumulation (AOP 27).

genes.name: Nuclear Factor Kappa-B Subunit 1 (NF-kB p105/p50)
genes.aop_ref: OECD AOP 27 & 34 (KE 149: Increased Inflammation & KE 87: Cytokine release)
genes.description: Central pro-inflammatory transcription factor. Takes over when chronic lipotoxicity or bile salt retention overwhelms the Nrf2 antioxidant buffer.

genes.name: Cellular Tumor Antigen p53
genes.aop_ref: OECD AOP 27 & 34 (KE 177: Mitochondrial dysfunction & Genomic stress checkpoint)
genes.description: Cellular stress and DNA damage sensor that initiates the tipping point toward programmed cell death (apoptosis) under persistent mitochondrial toxicity and inflammation.

genes.name: Caspase-3 (Apoptosis Executioner Caspase)
genes.aop_ref: OECD AOP 34 (AO 345: Steatosis/NASH) & AOP 27 (AO 357: Cholestatic apoptosis)
genes.description: Executioner protease for irreversible hepatocyte apoptosis (Adverse Outcome) after crossing the Waddington bifurcation point.

edges.citation: AOP34 (KE 264): NR1H3 activation transcriptionally upregulates SREBF1 expression
AOP34 (KE 54): LXR activation directly induces CD36 expression, enhancing FA uptake
AOP34 (KE 116): SREBP-1c drives transcription of FASN (De Novo Lipogenesis)
AOP34 (KE 89): SREBP-1c drives transcription of ACACA
AOP34 (KE 258): SREBP-1c drives transcription of SCD
Homeostasis: PPARA activation upregulates CPT1A to promote mitochondrial beta-oxidation
Cross-talk: PPARA activation counter-regulates/inhibits SREBP-1c lipogenic pathway
Homeostasis: Enhanced fatty acid flux stimulates VLDL assembly via MTTP
Homeostasis: MTTP and APOB co-regulate hepatic triglyceride export
Metabolic overload: Excessive lipogenesis suppresses PPARA compensatory signaling
AOP27/FXR (KE 288): NR1H4 transcriptionally maintains ABCB11 (BSEP) expression
AOP27/FXR: FXR activation represses CYP7A1 to prevent bile acid overload
AOP27/FXR: FXR downregulates basolateral uptake transporter SLC10A1 (NTCP)
Feedback: Bile acid synthesis intermediates activate FXR
AOP27 Pathology (KE 214): Loss of BSEP function leads to bile acid accumulation & Nrf2 stress
Steatotic Lipotoxicity: Excess CD36-mediated fatty acid influx triggers oxidative stress (Nrf2)
Cross-talk: Adaptive Nrf2 antioxidant response suppresses pro-inflammatory NF-kB signaling
Pathology (KE 149): Chronic inflammation and lipotoxicity activate TP53 stress response
Adverse Outcome: TP53 activation triggers CASP3-dependent hepatocyte apoptosis
AOP27 Pathology: Continued bile acid influx via NTCP exacerbates NF-kB inflammation
